nom: EQQUALBERRY Swimming Pool Toner - Korean Toner for Daily Exfoliating & Deep Hydration with Natural Enzyme Protease & Hya

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report good hydration and no irritation, though one reviewer with dry, very acne-prone skin developed acne despite otherwise finding it well-suited to dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including some with dry and oily areas or dehydration, report gentle exfoliation and comfortable hydration without stinging or redness.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea, report no irritation and even reduced redness, but one parent reports the toner caused a rash with tiny red bumps on her child's face.
segments.mature: The two reviewers who mention mature or aging skin report a plumper, smoother, more hydrated feel, with one noting the ingredients seem well suited to aging skin.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers report smoother skin and reduced fine lines with use, though one is unsure whether the improvement comes from the toner itself or from the serums she layers on top of it.
concerns.dehydration: Widely reported as effectively hydrating, including for reviewers who describe their skin as dry, dehydrated, or combination-dehydrated; one reviewer felt no visible difference after her first use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with rosacea, report reduced redness and no irritation, but two describe developing a bumpy, red rash on the face after a few days of use.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report their dark spots faded within one to two weeks of daily use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and some describe fewer blemishes over time, but two reviewers, including one with acne-prone skin, report the toner caused new breakouts on the face or body.

aspects.libelle: Packaging sometimes arrives damaged or unsealed

extraits.texte: Gave my kids rashes after using this. Started to have tiny bumps, red and itchiness all around his face. The product said Irritant-free. I dont think so. Not for sensitive skin at all.
Dry very acne prone skin Gave me acne which is disappointing bc I've been wanting to try it for so long and it's expensive. Great quality for dry skin if you aren't acne prone

This toner may very well work so well for most people but be very careful on how it works on you personally. I completely broke out on my legs but anywhere else on my body was fine I unfortunately have to stop using it im feeling extremely disappointed but this stuff happens when it comes to skin care so be careful guys.

I was a little skeptical how well this would perform, because it got so viral online. It’s hard to tell what to believe sometimes. Anyways, I have to say, this is actually a very decent toner! The texture is a lot like a serum, which I really like. The exfoliation is super gentle. I have sensitive skin, and I use this every other day or every two days. I could probably use this every day, but I don’t feel like I need to because this toner seems to do its job well. This will definitely last me a long time. I use this at night, and when I wake up I have noticed my complexion is a bit brighter and glowy/healthy. I think the berry extracts have something to do with it. It’s also quite hydrating but not sticky. I have combo skin that runs on the oily side, and I haven’t had any issues. SKIN TYPE: Combination-oily, dehydrated ROUTINE: Senka foaming face wash, Swimming Pool toner, Isntree Ultra HA toner or Torriden Dive in Serum, Dr 19 Peptide Jelly toner, Dr Althea 345 Cream or Torriden Dive In Cream

I have really started to love EQQUALBERRY products, and this Swimming Pool Toner is the latest reason why. I have sensitive skin and rosacea, so it can be difficult to find products that work with my skin, especially when so many skin care products contain fragrance (which I will never understand). Every EQQUALBERRY product I have tried so far has been fantastic, including this toner. This toner is fragrance-free, alcohol-free, and doesn't have other potentially sensitizing ingredients like essential oils. The ingredients are incredible and include things like panthenol, which my skin responds very well to. It feels funny to say that a toner is moisturizing, but this one is, thanks to the ingredients. My skin feels plumper and more hydrated after I use this toner; I put it on immediately after I take a shower to lock in moisture, and it's working really well for me. It applies easily and absorbs quickly, and there is no stickiness. Once it has fully absorbed, I apply my EQQUALBERRY serum. My skin looks and feels fantastic, and I attribute to these products and this toner in particular. It has been a real step up in my skincare. This is a wonderful product for sensitive skin or any skin type.

This is seriously the best exfoliate ever, no bs. If you have ever struggled with those tiny bumps on your skin that you can really pop or have stubborn skin texture, THIS IS PERFECT FOR YOU! It’s a lightweight hydrating consistency, which is perfect to use at night or day. I’ve had this toner for about 7-8 months and it’s still going strong! For reference, I have sensitive semi-dry skin. The only trouble I’ve had with this product is because I sometimes over use it. I notice when I use it every day and night consistently, my skin starts to freak out a little. Which is expected if you’re using an exfoliant everyday. (Please don’t over exfoliate your skin, it’s not fun) So i recommend using it every other day. This is truly an amazing product and it is so underrated. If you’re looking for a gentle exfoliation, this product is your best friend. Notes: I’ve found it actually fades my dark Spots And if you’re wondering if it has a scent, no it does not. I found results within a week and a half btw.

extraits.titre: Lightweight, Hydrating Toner with Great Ingredients
extraits.texte: This has become one of my favorite toners. It has a light, watery texture with a very slight body that spreads easily across the skin and absorbs quickly. There is only a slight tackiness at first; it fades completely once the product dries. The formula is fragrance free with a neutral pH, which I really appreciate. It also includes several excellent skin-friendly ingredients. Glycerin and beta glucan provide great hydration; panthenol, betaine, and allantoin help support the skin barrier. The fruit extracts add a very gentle exfoliating effect without feeling harsh. I have mature combination skin, and this works beautifully as part of my night routine. My skin feels fresh, hydrated, and noticeably plumper after using it.
